definition: [ עֲיָם ] noun [masculine] dubious, possibly glow (Arabic , to thirst , thirst, internal heat ), si vera lectio (so Du ; on form compare Nö ZMG xxxvii (1883), 526 ); — construct בֵּעְיָם רוּחוֺ Isa 11:15 , read perhaps בְּעֹצֶם (so apparently Vrss ) Thes Luzz Krochm Che Gu Kau Gr Perles Anal. 52 .
